name: Shuumatsu Iryou
source:
Main character is a son of a large company CEO. His good friend and secret love object Takumi Saeki becomes young director of the hospital. Suppressed feelings gradually turn into negative emotions. With the beginning of recession hospital undergoes a serious crisis. Protagonist decides to use this moment and give hospital a loan under severe conditions to drag female personnel to the bottom of despair. He overruns the body of a nurse who comes to negotiate. And this is only the beginning of the drama to take place here.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是大型企业总裁之子。他的好友兼暗恋对象佐伯巧巳年纪轻轻便成为医院院长，长久压抑的情感逐渐转化为负面情绪。经济衰退开始后，医院陷入严重危机。主角决定趁机提供条件苛刻的贷款，把院内女性职员拖入绝望深渊。他强行侵犯了前来谈判的护士，而这还只是医院惨剧的开端。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
